title: Cell and feature carry a persisted run state a reader can display without deriving it
action: Give the FEATURE a persisted run state, so a dashboard reads one field instead of inferring where a run stands (per D4, exposed per D7). Slice 1 already did this for the gate entry; this cell does it for the run as a whole. Add a `run_state` field to the workflow record with a closed vocabulary covering the states the lifecycle already has but cannot name: at minimum `shaping`, `awaiting-approval`, `running`, `blocked`, `done`. Persist it; never compute it at read time. Derive its initial value and its transitions from what the record already knows — phase, the gate entries slice 1 added, and the cell counts — but WRITE the result, so it survives a restart. Reject an unknown value with a typed error, matching the existing WORKFLOW_MISSING/WORKFLOW_CORRUPT discipline. `awaiting-approval` must be the value whenever a gate entry is `state: "pending"` and no later gate has been approved — that is the state the whole feature exists to make visible. CRITICAL, or this ships invisible: `apply_workflow_d1_fields` in workflow_store/projections.rs copies exactly `phase`, `feature`, `mode`, `approved_gates`, `summary`, `next_action` into `.bee/state.json`. A new record field does NOT reach the projection unless you add it there. The plan flags this explicitly: the byte-identical rebuild proof passes vacuously if `run_state` never projects, so add a test that asserts the projection actually CARRIES it, not merely that a rebuild round-trips. Then surface it in `bee status --json` beside the gate entries slice 1 exposed. On the CELL side, do not add new status values: the five (`open`, `claimed`, `capped`, `blocked`, `dropped`) already map onto waiting, running, blocked and done, and 41 call sites read them. Instead confirm in a test that a reader can tell those five apart from the feature's `run_state` without re-deriving either. If you conclude a genuinely new cell state IS needed, do not add it silently — record it as a deviation with the transition it names that the five cannot express.

truths: The workflow record persists run_state with a closed vocabulary, and an unknown value refuses with a typed error
run_state reads awaiting-approval whenever a gate entry is pending and none later is approved
run_state reaches .bee/state.json through apply_workflow_d1_fields, proven by a test asserting the projection carries it
bee status --json exposes run_state beside the gate entries
No new cell status value is introduced, and every pre-existing bee status --json key keeps its name, type, and meaning

artifacts.substantive: run_state field with validation and transition writes, no TODO stubs
tests for the vocabulary, the awaiting-approval rule, the invalid-value refusal, and the projection actually carrying the field

key_links: apply_workflow_d1_fields copies run_state, so the state.json projection is never missing it
prohibitions: No new cell status value without a recorded deviation naming the transition the five cannot express
No renaming or retyping of any existing bee status --json key
No dashboard, UI, or web surface

trace.outcome: Add a persisted run_state field to the workflow record (closed vocabulary: shaping/awaiting-approval/running/blocked/done), derived from status/gates/cell-counts and written on every create/update; extend apply_workflow_d1_fields so it reaches .bee/state.json; expose it in bee status --json beside gate_records; no new cell status value.

report.outcome: Persisted run_state on the workflow record with a closed 5-value vocabulary, derived from status + the D3 gate entries + a live cell-count scan, written on every create_workflow/update_workflow_assuming_lock_with call (never taken from a caller patch). Extended apply_workflow_d1_fields (and the sibling lane projection) to carry run_state into .bee/state.json — the CRITICAL trap the plan named. Exposed run_state in bee status --json beside gate_records. No new cell status value introduced.
